title: Chaliha, Ramraj Secure Semifinal Berths at Korea Masters
indian_angle: Two Indian women's singles players, Ashmita Chaliha and Rakshitha Ramraj, have advanced to the semifinals of the Korea Masters, guaranteeing an Indian finalist.
summary: Ashmita Chaliha stunned top seed Hina Akechi 20-22, 21-15, 21-19 to reach the Korea Masters semifinals, where she will face fellow Indian Rakshitha Ramraj, who also progressed.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp Begins in Guwahati
indian_angle: This camp is crucial for developing India's next generation of badminton talent for international junior championships.
summary: A national coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 has commenced at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: India's Medal Hopes at Home World Championships
indian_angle: This feature analyzes the medal chances of top Indian players like Sindhu, Lakshya, and Satwik-Chirag at the upcoming BWF World Championships hosted in India.
summary: With the BWF World Championships just around the corner, this article delves into the potential medal prospects for India's leading shuttlers, including PV Sindhu, Lakshya Sen, and the men's doubles pair of Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty.

title: World Junior Championships 2026 Selection Trials List Out
indian_angle: This update details the players eligible and qualified for the final selection trials to represent India at the upcoming World Junior Championships.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has released the list of eligible players and those qualified for the final selection trials for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026 in Cairo, Egypt.

title: Satwik's Shoulder Cleared Ahead of World Championships
indian_angle: A crucial update on Satwiksairaj Rankireddy's fitness is vital for Indian fans, as he and Chirag Shetty are major medal contenders at the home World Championships.
summary: Satwiksairaj Rankireddy's shoulder injury has received a green light, easing concerns for the star doubles player ahead of the BWF World Championships, though his coach remains cautious.
